articles.summary: Students without internships or formal work experience often struggle to create their first resume. This guide shows career centers how to help students identify relevant experiences, organize their information, use AI responsibly, and develop a usable first draft before advisor review.
articles.title: Helping Students Build Their First Resume: A Career Center Guide

articles.summary: A practical guide for college career centers to set up and manage a structured job shadowing program. Covers employer host recruitment, screening, student matching, scheduling, institutional approvals, cancellation procedures, and program evaluation.
articles.title: How Career Centers Can Set Up & Manage Job Shadowing Programs

articles.summary: A practical guide for career services teams training administrative student employees. Learn how to structure 30-day onboarding, assign front-desk and scheduling responsibilities, manage system permissions, establish escalation procedures, and standardize daily shift handovers.
articles.title: How to Train & Supervise Student Employees in Career Centers

articles.summary: A practical guide for career centers working with campus HR and hiring supervisors to incorporate NACE competencies into student job descriptions, standardize approvals, and pilot competency-aligned postings.
articles.title: How Career Centers Can Integrate NACE Competencies Into Campus Jobs

articles.summary: A practical guide for college career centers to build and manage employer sponsorship programs. Explore sponsor eligibility, contribution levels, sponsorship packages, contract terms, student access safeguards, performance measurement, and renewal decisions.
articles.title: How to Build & Manage Employer Sponsorship Programs in Career Centers
